name: Immutable Dual-Index Embedding Migration
mechanism: Builds a versioned challenger index from a frozen manifest, validates coverage, dual-reads or shadows it, and promotes by reversible alias switch.
use_when: Changing model revision dimension instructions or normalization
Rollback and uninterrupted service are required
avoid_when: Source and chunk manifests cannot be reproduced
Storage cannot temporarily hold champion and challenger
expected_effects: Fast rollback without rewriting champion vectors
failure_modes: Partial challenger coverage creates silent misses
Mixed embedding spaces are queried as one index
required_evals: latency cost and capacity during dual-read
